QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_23

question.text: Compliance Test Reporting (CTR) as prescribed in SEBI's July 31, 2023 Master Circular (Annexure 14) is MANDATORY for which category of AIFs?

answer.text: All AIFs (Cat I, II and III) alike.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 12: 'To ensure proper compliance and adherence with SEBI (AIF) Regulations and related circulars, the manager of a Category III AIF must prepare and submit a Compliance Test Report (CTR) as per the prescribed format.' The CTR content items are often relevant across categories, but the mandatory CTR submission is specifically framed as a Cat III Manager obligation. The Trap: Extending CTR to Cat I/II is a common confusion. Cat I/II Managers handle compliance via the annual investor report and quarterly SEBI filings, not the CTR. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same Cat III-only framing. On XIX-D (Cat I/II Manager), the correct answer MUST be that CTR is Cat III — but Cat I/II Managers should still know the CTR items as they overlap with their general transparency obligations. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even though CTR is a Cat III obligation, Cat I/II Managers should use the CTR template as a voluntary self-audit checklist — it crystallises all the Cat I/II general obligations into one diagnostic document.
